control_label_note: Control `name` is a best-effort label inferred from the JSX element's own aria-label/placeholder/title or the nearby JSX window. The authoritative control identity is `qubit_implementation` (file:line) plus `control_type`; labels may be approximate for elements without an inline accessible name.
disposition_rules: No control is IMPLEMENTED. A control/route/op is OPEN until an end-to-end chain is observed: input -> auth -> canonical op -> policy/broker/e-stop -> real runtime/provider -> persistent state/event -> correct result -> error/retry/cancel/recovery/audit. SAFE_EQUIVALENT is used only for typed-refusal gates whose counterpart names an in-tree canonical surface; the counterpart itself is not E2E-verified here.
